charges_parent_check.name: charges_parent_check
charges_parent_check.value: ("charges"."opd_appointment_id" is not null and "charges"."pharmacy_sale_id" is null) or ("charges"."pharmacy_sale_id" is not null and "charges"."opd_appointment_id" is null)

opd_appointments_identity_check.name: opd_appointments_identity_check
opd_appointments_identity_check.value: "opd_appointments"."patient_id" is not null or ("opd_appointments"."caller_name" is not null and "opd_appointments"."caller_phone" is not null)

opd_appointments_arrived_check.name: opd_appointments_arrived_check
opd_appointments_arrived_check.value: "opd_appointments"."status" <> 'checked_in' or ("opd_appointments"."patient_id" is not null and "opd_appointments"."token_number" is not null and "opd_appointments"."arrived_at" is not null)

opd_appointments_booked_check.name: opd_appointments_booked_check
opd_appointments_booked_check.value: "opd_appointments"."status" <> 'booked' or ("opd_appointments"."arrival_mode" = 'scheduled' and "opd_appointments"."token_number" is null and "opd_appointments"."arrived_at" is null)

invoices_parent_check.name: invoices_parent_check
invoices_parent_check.value: ("invoices"."stream" = 'opd' and "invoices"."opd_appointment_id" is not null and "invoices"."patient_id" is not null and "invoices"."pharmacy_sale_id" is null) or ("invoices"."stream" = 'pharmacy' and "invoices"."pharmacy_sale_id" is not null and "invoices"."opd_appointment_id" is null)

refunds_invoice_source_check.name: refunds_invoice_source_check
refunds_invoice_source_check.value: ("refunds"."invoice_id" is not null) = ("refunds"."credit_note_id" is not null)

stock_movements_sign_check.name: stock_movements_sign_check
stock_movements_sign_check.value: ("stock_movements"."reason" in ('sale', 'writeoff', 'breakage', 'internal_issue') and "stock_movements"."qty" < 0) or ("stock_movements"."reason" in ('opening', 'receipt', 'return') and "stock_movements"."qty" > 0) or ("stock_movements"."reason" in ('release', 'quarantine', 'count_correction'))
